Name: Volcano Dungeon Key
Author: TacNotCat
Description:
[b][size=5]Volcano Dungeon Key[/size][/b]
Tired of running back and forth over volcano pressure plates? Craft a key and let it
step on them for you.

[b]HOW TO GET ONE[/b]
[list]
[*]Buy the recipe at [b]Mr. Qi's Walnut Room[/b] for [b]30 Qi Gems[/b] (the entry
disappears after purchase, just like vanilla recipe items).[/*]
[*]Craft it: [b]4 Iridium Bars + 1 Prismatic Shard + 1 Dragon Tooth = 4 keys[/b].[/*]
[*]Or get lucky: see the drop sources below.[/*]
[/list][b]HOW TO USE[/b]
[list]
[*]Hold the key, stand within 3 tiles of a [b]locked dwarf gate inside the Volcano
Dungeon[/b], and press the [b]use tool / attack button[/b] (left click by default).[/*]
[*][b]1 key = 1 pressure plate pressed for you.[/b] A gate with N unpressed plates
needs N keys; if you already stepped on K of them, you only need N-K.[/*]
[*]Nothing to press nearby? The key is [b]not[/b] consumed.[/*]
[*]The entrance lava-river shortcut gate is deliberately [b]excluded[/b], so you
cannot skip the dungeon.[/*]
[/list][b]HOW IT WORKS (why it behaves like vanilla)[/b]
The key fires the game's own gate press-event, exactly as if you had stood on the
plate yourself. Sound effects, plates turning from red to green, the counter, the
gate opening and [b]multiplayer sync[/b] are all the original code path. In
multiplayer, a client asks the host to simulate the press and the user's own key is
consumed.

[b]SIX EXTRA DROP SOURCES[/b]
All of them are locked behind [b]reaching the Volcano Dungeon[/b] by default (the
same vanilla progress flag that gates cinder shards in skull chests):
[list]
[*]Volcano monster kill — 1% (1 key)[/*]
[*]Volcano metal crate — 5% (1 key)[/*]
[*]Golden Coconut cracked at Clint's — 10% ([b]1-3 keys[/b])[/*]
[*]Mystery Box at Clint's — 2%[/*]
[*]Golden Mystery Box at Clint's — 5%[/*]
[*]Skull Cavern treasure-room chest (level 121+) — 3% (replaces the usual loot)[/*]
[/list][b]CONFIGURATION[/b]
Every rate above and the "must reach the volcano first" gate are stored in
[b]config.json[/b] inside the mod folder and can be changed without reinstalling.

[b]INSTALL[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder so that you have
Mods\VolcanoDungeonKey\manifest.json, then start the game through SMAPI.
Name, description and messages switch automatically with your game language
(English / 简体中文).

[b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0[/b] or newer (Stardew Valley 1.6.x).[/*]
[/list][b]KNOWN ISSUES / NOTES[/b]
[list]
[*]On a brand-new save the drop sources stay silent until you reach the Volcano
Dungeon for the first time — that is the intended gate, not a bug.[/*]
[*]The Skull Cavern treasure chest source [b]replaces[/b] the normal treasure; set
its chance to 0 if you want the vanilla loot back.[/*]
[*]Uninstalling: consume or drop leftover keys first. The mod itself touches no
quest state, so removing the folder is otherwise save-safe.[/*]
[*]Harmony patches Monster.deathAnimation, BreakableContainer.releaseContents,
Utility.getTreasureFromGeode, MineShaft.getTreasureRoomItem and
ShopMenu.tryToPurchaseItem — a mod rewriting the same methods may conflict.[/*]
[/list][b]FEEDBACK[/b]
Please post on the Comments tab with your SMAPI log if a gate does not react or a
drop never happens.

[b][size=4]火山地牢钥匙（中文版）[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]获取[/b]：姜岛齐先生的核桃房花 30 齐钻购买配方；制作：4 铱锭 + 1 五彩碎片 + 1 龙牙 = 4 把钥匙。[/*]
[*][b]用法[/b]：举着钥匙站在火山地牢内锁着的矮人栅栏门 3 格内，按「使用工具/攻击」键（默认左键）。
一把钥匙替你按下一个压力板；门有 N 个未踩机关就需 N 把，自己先踩过 K 个则只需 N−K 把；
附近没有可按的机关时不消耗钥匙；入口岩浆河捷径大门被排除，不能用来跳过火山。[/*]
[*][b]原理[/b]：调用原版 gate 的压力板事件，音效、按钮红点变绿、计数、开门与联机同步全部与
玩家亲自踩板完全一致；联机中客机请主机模拟踩板，消耗使用者自己的钥匙。[/*]
[*][b]额外 6 种来源[/b]（默认需先抵达火山地牢才开放）：火山怪物击杀 1%、火山金属箱 5%、
铁匠铺砸金椰子 10%（掉 1~3 把）、谜之盒 2%、金色谜之盒 5%、骷髅洞宝藏房宝箱 3%（替换原战利品）。[/*]
[*][b]配置[/b]：以上概率与门控开关都在 mod 目录 config.json 中，无需重装即可改。[/*]
[*][b]安装[/b]：解压到 Mods 目录，使 Mods\VolcanoDungeonKey\manifest.json 存在即可。[/*]
[*][b]需求[/b]：SMAPI 4.0.0 及以上（星露谷 1.6.x），无其他依赖。[/*]
[*][b]注意[/b]：新档在首次抵达火山地牢前，额外掉落途径按设计保持关闭；
骷髅洞宝藏房途径会替换原战利品，想保留原版奖励请把该项概率设为 0。[/*]
[/list]----------------------------------------------------------------

Manifest.Name: Volcano Dungeon Key
Manifest.Description: Adds a craftable Volcano Dungeon Key. Buy the recipe at Mr. Qi's Walnut Room for 30 Qi Gems; craft 4 iridium bars + 1 prismatic shard + 1 dragon tooth to get 4 keys. Left-click near a locked dwarf gate in the Volcano Dungeon to press one pressure plate (vanilla, MP-synced). Extra sources — volcano monster kills, metal crates, golden coconuts, mystery boxes, golden mystery boxes and Skull Cavern treasure chests — are gated behind reaching the Volcano Dungeon (same mail flag as vanilla cinder shards); all rates and the gate switch are tunable in config.json.
Manifest.Author: Trae
